#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <numeric>
#include <limits>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

vector<ll> f(30);

ll solve(ll n){
    if(n <= 6) return n;
    ll r1 = numeric_limits<ll>::max(), r2 = numeric_limits<ll>::max();
    
    for(int i = 0; i < 20; i++)
        if(f[i] > n){
            r1 = solve(n%f[i-1]) + i*(n/f[i-1]);
            break;
        }
    for(int i = 0; i < 20; i++)
        if(f[i] >= n){
            if(f[i]-n >= n) r2 = numeric_limits<ll>::max();
            else r2 = solve(f[i] - n) + (i+1);
            break;
        }
    
    return min(r1,r2);
}

int main(){
    
    f[0] = 1;
    for(int i = 1; i < 18; i++)
        f[i] = f[i-1]*10 + 1;

    ll n; cin >> n;
    cout << solve(n) << endl;
    
	return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
